protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed independently. In server mode, an unauthenticated MySQL-protocol client can execute CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE. Registered json_reader/csv_reader modules pass their caller-controlled source to openMmapedFile/downloadFile, whose go-getter client accepts remote URLs without an IP, scheme, or metadata-address restriction, enabling SSRF to loopback, private networks, and 169.254.169.254.

Its cohesive feature diff adds module/helper.go with unrestricted getter.Client, adds read_json.go/read_csv.go, and registers json_reader/csv_reader on Namespace.Register, which the pre-existing server path already uses. git log -S getter.Client identifies this commit as the first write; later 05c4dea951597e087a43e061b322f62893e833fb merely adds log_reader using the existing helper.

protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state: Confirmed 27f84fc168310455eaf81ec4ba87eed20298670c is the direct mechanism fix: server sandboxing is enabled by default, RestrictionsFromFlags leaves AllowRemote false unless explicitly relaxed, CheckSource rejects remote sources, go-getter is restricted to the file getter, and all reader modules receive the restrictions object.
